greeting: Inspector. A dreadful business. I have already prepared a list of everyone's cabin numbers, should it assist.
{Victim.full}. I logged the report myself. I never thought I should have to enter a death in the ledger.
Regulation forty-one requires me to co-operate fully with any lawful inquiry, Inspector. I intend to exceed it.
Please be brief. The accounts must be closed before New York, murder or no murder.
I had {victim}'s account open on my desk only this evening. One doesn't expect— well. Shall we begin?
Do sit, Inspector. Mind the inkwell. I keep things orderly, and I'd ask you to keep them so.
whereabouts: {RoomName}, {time}. I noted the minute; I can fetch the log if you require it.
I was {room} {time}. To be precise about it.
{Time}? {RoomName}. Write it down correctly, please; people so often get it wrong.
{Time} I was {room}. I keep a strict timetable, Inspector, as the regulations require.
I was {room}, {time}. That is the exact position.
{RoomName}. {Time}, near enough. I dislike 'near enough', but there it is.
{Time}, Inspector, I was {room}. You may quote me.
sawOne: {Other} was present. I made a note of it.
I observed {other}. {Other.subject} did not see me, I believe.
Only {other}. I nodded; it is customary.
{Other} was there. I can give you {other.possessive} cabin number, if that is of use.
There was {other}. Whether {other.subject} had any business being there is another matter.
{Other}. I recorded it in my pocketbook at the time.
sawSeveral: {Others}. I counted them, as is my habit.
There were {others}. Rather a crowd for the hour.
{Others} were present. I could list them alphabetically, if you prefer.
{Others}. Not one of them had a word for me, naturally.
Let me consult my notes. Yes: {others}.
sawVictim: {Victim} was there. Alive, and complaining about the service, as I recall.
I saw {victim}. I entered nothing remarkable in my book. I wish now that I had.
{Victim}, yes. {Victim.subject} asked me something about the accounts. I said I would look into it.
I observed {victim}. {Victim.subject} seemed entirely well. I can't account for what came after.
{Victim} was present. I made a note. I make a note of everyone.
Yes, I saw {victim}. I keep thinking of it. A purser oughtn't to keep thinking of things.
sawNoOne: No one. The regulations do not require company.
Nobody, Inspector. I prefer to work undisturbed.
I saw no one. I should have noted it if I had.
No one at all. My pocketbook is quite blank on the point.
Nobody. Is that irregular? I don't believe it's irregular.
confrontCrack: {Witness} said that? I— Very well. I shall have to amend the record.
Ah. Regulation— no. There isn't a regulation for this. I'll tell you.
{Witness} has a good memory. Inconveniently good. Please close the door.
I see. I— I must ask that this not go in your report. Not in full.
confrontDeflect: {Witness} is mistaken. I keep a written record; {witness.subject} keeps none.
With respect, Inspector, my account is correct to the minute. {Witness}'s is not.
I shall not amend my statement on the word of {witness}. It would be irregular.
{Witness} saw someone, perhaps. Not me. Half the crew wear navy blue.
accusedWrongly: Me? With {weapon}? Inspector, I am an assistant purser. I file things.
This is most irregular. I shall be making a written complaint to the Line.
I did not kill {victim}. I have never broken a regulation in my life. Not a serious one.
Murder? I can barely bring myself to fine a steward for a lost teaspoon.
accusedRightly: {Victim} had seen the ledgers, Inspector. The real ones. I couldn't let that reach the Line.
{Weapon}. Yes. It was untidy. I dislike untidiness more than I can say.
I borrowed. Only borrowed. {Victim.subject} called it theft, and was going to say so in New York.
{RoomName}, {weapon}, and twenty-two years of spotless service gone. I should like it noted that I confessed promptly.
opinion.marble: {Other} is a most distinguished passenger. Most distinguished. I couldn't possibly comment on {other.possessive} account.
{Other.subject} tips in promises, Inspector. I have a drawer full of them.
I hold {other} in the very highest regard. As does {other.possessive} bank, I'm sure. For now.
opinion.mallet: {Other} has complained about {other.possessive} cabin three times. I have the forms.
{Other.subject} is very loud. I'm told it's a sporting quality.
{Other} called me a fusspot. I have noted it.
opinion.bear: {Other} is— very friendly. Very. I try to keep the desk between us.
{Other.subject} asks a great many questions about cabin numbers. I give {other.object} none. Well. Very few.
{Other} calls me a useful man. I'm not sure it's a compliment. I'm not sure I mind.
opinion.egg: {Other} keeps asking for the passenger list. Regulation nine forbids it. I've told {other.object} so twice.
{Other.subject} writes things down. I write things down. But I know why I do it.
A nervous young lady. I suspect {other.object} of something. I've no idea what. That's what worries me.
opinion.pail: {Other} is a steward of the second grade, and cheeky with it.
I have reason to believe {other} runs a card game below decks. I simply haven't caught {other.object} yet.
{Other.subject} calls me 'sir' in a manner I find impossible to put on a form.
eulogy.marble: {Other}. Dead. And {other.possessive} account still outstanding. I'm sorry; it's habit.
A very distinguished passenger. I shall see that {other.possessive} effects are properly inventoried.
I had my disagreements with {other.object}. Financial ones. I shan't speak of them now.
eulogy.mallet: {Other}. I gave {other.object} the worst cabin on the deck. I wish I hadn't.
{Other.subject} complained three times. I'd give a good deal to hear a fourth.
Very forthright. Very. I filed every one of {other.possessive} complaints. I shall keep them now.
eulogy.bear: {Other}. {Other.subject} called me a useful man. Nobody else ever has.
The ship will be very quiet. I never thought I should regret quiet.
{Other.subject} teased me dreadfully. I'm afraid I rather looked forward to it.
eulogy.egg: Poor {other}. All those requests for the passenger list. I should have just given it to {other.object}.
{Other.subject} was harmless, I'm sure. I'm almost sure. I was never quite sure.
A young lady travelling alone. The Line will have to write to {other.possessive} family. I suppose I shall draft it.
eulogy.pail: {Other}. Cheeky, idle, and the best steward on B Deck. Don't tell anyone I said so.
I'd been trying to catch {other.object} at cards all voyage. Now I never shall.
I shall have to reassign {other.possessive} duties. I don't know who'll do them with that grin.
